descriptions.text: Warning: This will drain any magical item, but it will only transfer to a like item. If you drain a ring, the stored buff will only be transferred to an absorption crystal affixed to a ring. If you attempt to transfer to an incompatible item, the buff will be lost.

beats.headline: Not a hat
beats.text: Donut has just received the Tiara of a Thousand Lights when a second benefactor box arrives, a platinum from the Apothecary. It is not a hat, as Carl expected, but another charging pillow, almost identical to the one that came with the tiara: ten hours to transfer fully, and the item ruined after one. This one is purple instead of red, and the warning at the end of its description is different. Almost a universal charger, Carl says, and tells Donut to check that an item is listed as a hat first. With two, she can fill the tiara twice as fast.

beats.headline: Two hats, two pillows
beats.text: Donut puts the pillows on the counter, her new boonie hat on the red one and her Tiara of the Inebriated Dragonfly on the other. Each makes an audible click as it touches; there is no other notification. What if the cleaner bot knocks it over, she asks. Mordecai tells her not to worry: once locked in place, an item has to be peeled off, like a magnet. She can move them to her room if she likes.

beats.headline: The catch-all, left empty
beats.text: Katia pulls two of Donut's drained hats off the charging pillows and sets the tiara on each in turn, and three more of its jewels light up: twenty-three buffs, seventy-six to go. She puts a plastic baseball cap on the pillow next. The other, catch-all pillow she leaves empty for the moment. They agree that for the next one, the pillow will go in a different room.

relations.note: a second charger for the tiara
